declarations.name: computePeaks
declarations.description: `count` peaks from 0 to 1, each the loudest sample of its slice of `samples`.

Waveform playback for voice notes and recordings, as Slack clips and WhatsApp voice messages play them: a play
button, the waveform as the seek bar, the time and a speed toggle.

The audio is `src`, played by an `<audio>` of the player's own, or an `<audio>` the author puts in the default slot
(with its `<source>`s; leave `controls` off). The player never writes on a slotted element. `media` is the element
either way, to hand to `c2-transcript` or `c2-audio-visualizer`.

The waveform comes from `peaks`, numbers from 0 to 1 usually stored with the recording, brought to `bars` bars (fewer
when the waveform is too narrow for them: as many as fit at the bar width and gap).
Without `peaks`, the player fetches and decodes `src` once with Web Audio (it must be same-origin, or served with
CORS) and computes them; when that fails the bars stay flat. With `preload="none"` it waits for the first play.
`duration` (seconds) shows the length before any metadata loads, so a list of voice notes need not fetch every file.

The waveform is the seek bar: click or drag on it, or focus it and use the arrow keys (5 seconds), Home and End;
Space plays and pauses. The played bars take the accent colour. The speed button cycles 1×, 1.5× and 2×.
`exclusive` pauses any other exclusive player on the page when this one starts, as in a chat. `transcript` (text) or
the `transcript` slot adds a toggle that shows the transcript below. `variant="bubble"` is the compact chat look,
with the time under the waveform; the `avatar` slot sits before the play button.

The player is a group named by `label`. `play`, `pause`, `ended` and `ratechange` are re-fired on the host.

cssProperties.description: Space between the play button, the waveform, the time and the speed.
cssProperties.name: --c2-audio-player--gap

cssProperties.description: The message shown when the audio cannot play.
cssProperties.name: --c2-audio-player__error--color

cssProperties.description: The opacity of a player that cannot play.
cssProperties.name: --c2-audio-player--disabled-opacity

cssParts.description: The row that holds the controls.
cssParts.name: player

cssParts.description: The waveform, which is the seek bar.
cssParts.name: waveform

slots.description: Shown before the play button: the sender of a voice message.
slots.name: avatar

slots.description: The transcript, shown below the player when opened (a `c2-transcript` given this player's `media`, or text).
slots.name: transcript

members.name: src
members.description: The audio file, played by an `<audio>` of the player's own. Ignored while an `<audio>` is slotted.

members.name: label
members.description: Names the player and its play button ("Play voice note from Ana").

members.name: peaks
members.description: The waveform: numbers from 0 to 1. Without it, the player computes it from `src` when it can fetch the file.

members.name: bars
members.description: The most bars the waveform draws; a narrow waveform draws as many as fit.

members.name: duration
members.description: The length in seconds, shown before the audio's metadata has loaded.

members.name: exclusive
members.description: Pauses every other `exclusive` player on the page when this one starts.

members.name: transcript
members.description: A text transcript, shown below the player behind a toggle. The `transcript` slot takes richer content.

members.name: preload
members.description: How much of the player's own `<audio>` loads up front, as on `<audio>`. `none` also waits for a play to compute the waveform.

members.name: fitted
members.description: How many bars fit the waveform, measured after the first render (which draws `bars`, as the server does).

members.name: media
members.description: The `<audio>` that plays: the slotted one, or the player's own.

members.name: measure
members.description: As many bars as fit the waveform's width at the bar width and gap the theme sets, up to `bars`.

members.name: tick
members.description: Follows the playhead every frame while playing, so the played bars advance smoothly.

members.name: maybeDecode
members.description: Fetches and decodes the audio once to draw its waveform, when no `peaks` are given.

events.description: The audio played to its end.
events.name: ended
